title: Diabetes and kidney risk review
summary: A1c remains elevated with albuminuria and reduced eGFR. Patient has recent ED visit for symptomatic hyperglycemia.
assessment: High risk for diabetes complications and kidney progression if glycemic control remains poor.
plan: Review medication adherence, consider intensification per clinician judgment, reinforce glucose logs and BP control.
follow_up: Recheck BMP and urine albumin in 4 weeks; follow up within 1 week after medication adjustment.

title: COPD discharge review
summary: Recent inpatient stay for COPD exacerbation. Oxygen saturation was low at presentation and WBC elevated.
assessment: Moderate-to-high readmission risk due to recent exacerbation and prior smoking history.
plan: Confirm inhaler technique, complete steroid/antibiotic course, review rescue inhaler use and red flags.
follow_up: Pulmonology follow-up within 7 days; revisit sooner for worsening dyspnea or fever.

title: Heart failure transition review
summary: BNP markedly elevated with renal function vulnerability after decompensated heart failure admission.
assessment: High risk for recurrent volume overload and medication-related electrolyte issues.
plan: Daily weight monitoring, medication reconciliation, low sodium counseling, and close potassium/creatinine monitoring.
follow_up: Cardiology follow-up in 3-5 days; repeat CMP before visit.
